note: Spring Lake Village — the real production transcription of three photographed brochure pages, plus the per-chunk results of the run that structured it under `auto` (these are the STAGED results, i.e. already past that run's own enforcement) and the single item the `keep_together` run published.

Residential Living
Monthly Fee Agreement
2026 - 2027

A Month-to-Month Agreement gives you the ability to simply pay a one time Community Fee and
an ongoing monthly fee. We are offering a select grouping of studio and one-bedroom apartments.

Select Apartments	MONTHLY FEE*

Little River	$6,396
Studio Apartment, 490 sq ft

Timber Cove	$6,493
Alcove Apartment, 530 sq ft

Forestville	$6,545
1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom, 580 sq ft

Fulton	$7,077
1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom, 650 sq ft

Glen Ellen	$8,879
1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom, 690 sq ft

Lakeville	$9,665
1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom, 730 sq ft

2nd person	+$1,085

Community Fee**	$6,500
Non-refundable Application Fee	$500

*Your monthly fee is subject to annual increases and additional charges will apply for personal assistance services.
**The Community Fee is refundable according to the terms of the admission agreement.

Fees listed are as of April 1, 2026 and are subject to change.

Great life, beautiful setting.

Surrounded by rolling hills, vineyards and Santa Rosa Creek, Spring Lake Village is a naturally beautiful place to live. Add to that the good people who call this community home and you have a recipe for a great lifestyle. This is a place where life is enjoyed. Whether you're sipping wine by the firepit, playing in a bocce tournament, enjoying one of the topnotch eateries, taking a class or listening to an impromptu concert in the Great Hall, you have plenty of options. Our residents share a love for easy living with the comforts of home.

Spring Lake Village offers an opportunity to join the community under a monthly agreement with no entrance fee.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED
- Lots of ways to lead a meaningful life
- Dining options to suit any taste
- Gardens, courtyards, classes and activities
- Lake walks, hiking trails and bocce
- Bustling, down-to-earth community
- Participative and wellness-focused culture
- 24-hour security
- Independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing and memory care available

All the ingredients for
an engaging life.

Stay engaged, be involved and get creative with all kinds of opportunities and amenities.
Take advantage of our award-winning wellness programs, offering everything from water
aerobics and line dancing to yoga and Tai Chi. Keep your calendar full with activities,
including lectures, bocce tournaments and book clubs.

COMMUNITY AMENITIES

- Flexible dining plan offering dining points
  equal to one meal daily for our lively Bistro,
  elegant Sonoma Room or take out service

- Wide variety of resident-initiated and
  organized social, cultural, educational and
  recreational programs and events

- Personalized programs and resources for
  body, mind and spirit

- Scheduled transportation

- Lush landscaping with courtyards, walking
  paths and beautiful resident-tended gardens

- Studios for art, media, cultural
  programs and wood shop

- Spacious auditorium, beautiful Great Hall,
  theater, lounge, conference space and
  meeting rooms for social gathering

- Library, media room, billiards room, chapel,
  contemplative labyrinth and boutique gift
  shop

- Fitness center with heated indoor swimming
  pool and spa and cardio and weight
  equipment designed for older people

- Floor- and water-based exercise classes with
  options for personal training

- Massage, skin, hair and nail care salon
  services for an additional fee

- Parking for an additional fee and electric
  charging port

- Pets welcome

- Dog run

- On-site bank

HOUSEHOLD AMENITIES

- Inviting kitchen with upscale appliances

- Washer and dryer and ample closets

- Interior and exterior maintenance

- Housekeeping and flat linen service, bi-monthly

- Electricity, gas, heat, air conditioning, water,
  sewer, trash removal, Wi-Fi

- 24-hour security

- Emergency response system

ADDITIONAL MONTHLY FEES:

Basic Cable: $27
Telephone Land Line: $5
Parking: Covered $50; Uncovered $28
Personal Internet

springlakevillage-sr.org

We're an equal opportunity housing provider.
License #301016556 / COA #357
